title: Special Height Limitations
previewText: The provisions of this Section, inclusive, shall apply to buildings utilizing the sky exposure plane provisions of this Chapter. In no event shall such provisions apply to buildings that utilize the residential height and setback regulations of Section 23-40, inclusive.
